name: Desiree Banugo
title: Digital and social media marketing consultant
bio_short: Integrated marketing consultant specialising in digital and social media with 19 years' experience. Clients include Lloyds Banking Group, IBM, Shell, Vodafone and Jaguar. Has worked across 20 industries and 50+ brands.
bio: Desirée is an integrated marketing consultant specialising in digital and social media. Over the last 19 years, she has developed strategies and managed campaigns for brands, creative agencies and entrepreneurs at national and global level. In that time, she has worked across nearly 20 industries and over 50 brands to create or refine strategy, develop compelling content, build communities, establish online brand personas and increase customer response. She has been involved with many website builds, social media platform launches, online business expansions, mentoring and training development. Her client roster includes Lloyds Banking Group, IBM, Yahoo!, Shell, DeBeers, Jaguar, Vodafone, and British Film Institute and agency partners include Tequila, TMP, Wunderman & Rapp.
bio_long: Desirée is an integrated marketing consultant specialising in digital and social media. Over the last 19 years, she has developed strategies and managed campaigns for brands, creative agencies and entrepreneurs at national and global level. In that time, she has worked across nearly 20 industries and over 50 brands to create or refine strategy, develop compelling content, build communities, establish online brand personas and increase customer response. She has been involved with many website builds, social media platform launches, online business expansions, mentoring and training development. Her client roster includes Lloyds Banking Group, IBM, Yahoo!, Shell, DeBeers, Jaguar, Vodafone, and British Film Institute, and agency partners include Tequila, TMP, Wunderman and Rapp. Desirée's breadth of sector experience is a significant asset in her training. Having worked across financial services, luxury goods, energy, technology and the cultural sector, she understands that digital and social media strategies must be tailored to specific audiences, brand requirements and business objectives. She does not teach a one-size-fits-all approach. Her training sessions are practical and hands-on, with participants working on real-world scenarios drawn from her extensive project portfolio. She covers the full lifecycle of digital communications, from strategic planning and audience analysis through content development, community management and performance measurement. She is particularly strong on the relationship between content quality and business outcomes, helping participants move beyond vanity metrics to understand what genuinely drives engagement and conversion.
